invariants.rationale: Method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, likely non-null for successful execution.

invariants.expression: preppedRecords != null && result.getWriteStatuses() != null && preppedRecords.size() >= result.getWriteStatuses().size()
invariants.rationale: Each WriteStatus typically corresponds to a batch of records inserted; the number of write statuses should not exceed the number of input records.
The returned metadata should reflect the commit time that was passed to the method.
A successful bulk insert should result in at least one WriteStatus in the returned metadata.
List sizes are non-negative in Java, so negative sizes are not possible.
